## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-cross-hardware-reproducibility`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-cross-hardware-reproducibility -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `data/cards.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `verify.py`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `paper/paper.pdf`
- `data/cards.jsonl`
- `data/items.jsonl`
- `paper/numbers.json`
- `data/runtimes.jsonl`
- See the Data tab for all 174 files.

# Cross-hardware reproducibility of LLM evaluation results (item level)

> **Start here — free verify:**

## Dataset facts (checked 2026-11-20)

- Kaggle version 3, last updated 2026-10-16.
- 174 files, 27,236,438 bytes. File types: .json (159), .jsonl (7), .py (4), .ots (2), .md (1), .pdf (1).
- Hugging Face twin: [csoai/cross-hardware-reproducibility](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/cross-hardware-reproducibility). 171 of 174 files have the same byte size there.
- Expected update frequency: never.
